01 / About

Curious by nature. Analytical by design.

Mashook Mohammad Meshkat
Associate Data Scientist · WeGro Technologies

I'm a data and analytics professional with experience developing reporting systems, automating business workflows, building dashboards, and supporting data-driven decisions across operational and financial functions.

At WeGro Technologies, I work across Python, SQL, relational databases, BigQuery and BI tools to turn operational data into structured reporting and analytical solutions. My work includes recurring report automation, KPI frameworks, MIS systems and predictive modelling.

Alongside industry work, I have contributed to peer-reviewed research in precision agriculture, autonomous driving and sustainable energy systems. I hold a BSc in Electrical & Electronic Engineering with a minor in Computer Science from BRAC University.
